title: Obsidian Gauntlet
description: The Glowing Obsidian Gauntlet from Minecraft: Story Mode.
body:
> "I hope you're learning how to be a cooperative champion... You are all here, to be reminded of your potential. And I hope you will see it in yourself, as I do. Because if you don't... well... we'll cross that bridge if we come to it, 'ey? In the meantime, demonstrate your cooperative potential, and you just may become the ultimate champion!"
---
## About
Basically remodels the mace to the Glowing Obsidian Gauntlet from Minecraft: Story Mode - Season 2


<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

Disable the 2nd layer on the left or right arm if the skin overlays the glowing thingamajig.

And credits to the person from telltale/mcsm team who made the texture.

</details>
